checks.name: Auth layout and keyboard entry
checks.evidence: One original bee, no roaming layer; keyboard skip link focuses the form.

checks.name: Login validation
checks.evidence: Empty and malformed inputs focus the first invalid field and expose associated inline errors.

checks.name: Password privacy
checks.evidence: Both visibility states work and the supplied shy clip responds to password focus/reveal.

checks.name: Real Firebase login error round trip

evidence.message: That email and password didn’t match. Check your details and try again.
evidence.note: Reserved nonexistent account; successful sign-in not claimed.

checks.name: Password recovery UI and Firebase request
checks.evidence: Reset API request type/email verified with an intercepted success response; neutral confirmation and return focus work. No real reset email sent.

checks.name: Google Sign-In initiation
checks.evidence: Existing Firebase signInWithPopup opened its google.com provider handler. Provider page intercepted, popup closed, and retry feedback verified; no Google account authenticated.

checks.name: Signup validation and page transition
checks.evidence: SPA switch preserves the document. Both signup steps, required name/email, Edit details with retained values, six-character minimum, mismatch/match feedback, length guide and confirm-password visibility work.

checks.name: Registration service boundary and loading
checks.evidence: Existing signup service received entered email/password; request intercepted with EMAIL_EXISTS to avoid creating production data. Loading disables submit; useful retry error appears.

evidence.emailAcknowledgement: original wave plays once and returns to still
evidence.password: original shy clip holds its real closed-eye pose at 1.7 seconds while focused

checks.name: Photographic story interaction
checks.evidence: Notice, Connect and Act update their real local photograph and explanatory copy; images loaded successfully.

checks.name: Responsive composition and themes
checks.evidence: Both routes checked at 320, 390, 768, 1024 and 1440px; no horizontal overflow and bee never intersects fields, provider button, submit or mode links. Light/dark screenshots saved.

checks.name: Reduced motion
checks.evidence: Live system preference and application motion switch both suppress original video reactions and CSS entry transitions.

checks.name: Large text and contrast
checks.evidence: 390px viewport at 20px root font size has no horizontal overflow; high-contrast styling inspected.

checks.name: Browser runtime
checks.evidence: No unhandled page exceptions or unexpected console errors; Firebase 400 test responses accounted for.
